inspection.observation: Actual fossil photographs and labelled outlines show the marked five left/right anterior pairs, long slender middle and expanded posterior. Tube-bearing specimen A/D has an associated elongate coarse-walled structure. Flattening/curvature differ among specimens; neither establishes exact life posture.

Dorsal holotype and lateral specimen show limb cluster near head and a much longer limbless body. Lateral drawing marks small trunk spines and possible antenniform structures with a question mark. C/F depicts the posterior expansion and hook marking. Whole-body extents vary by preservation.

Facivermis panels A/C show small paired marks at the head. Comparative Luolishania panels B/D include different anatomy; do not copy its sclerite. The paper interprets the Facivermis marks as simple ocular structures, not compound or stalked eyes.
